log.msg: Dawn, day 1. Snowbound Taiga. Always cold. Snow can be melted for water if you have fuel.
Somewhere to the east there is a town. Find it: its people know what this land is waiting for.
Your camp has a well. A cloak, a lantern and fuel are stored here: open Pack to take them.
A year of storms. Storms come twice as often.
God mode: nothing can see you, hurt you or stop you.
You are in the Land of Long Shadows: Smoke Fells (1, 2).
God mode is off. You are mortal again.
